name: Paddlebill · Gremlet #43
description:
A platypus that can't decide if it's a duck, a beaver or an otter, and is happy being all three.

One of 50 one-of-a-kind Gremlets. Owning this token unlocks Paddlebill in the Gremlets desktop app, where it walks on your windows, naps, plays with other Gremlets and shows off its signature move.
